title: uguu.space pack
description: Pack with a focus on technical mods (Create, Ad Astra, AE2), while keeping it optimized.
body:
![anime girl on a dirt background and drop shadow behind the image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/72219415b5ef581b0f9854d2c7ef2d408fb2cbd9.png)
## Overview
This is a pack of mods used on uguu.space private Minecraft server. The server is intended for **friends only** as of now but that doesn't mean the mod pack isn't public. You can live out your own adventure!

## Main features
- **Create mod** - allowing you building various contraptions and providing different avenues for automation
- **Applied Energistics 2** - allows for further automation, additionally provides an alternative storage system
- **Ad Astra** - visit the planets! Literally a rocket science mod!
- **ComputerCraft: Tweaked** - adding functional computers to Minecraft, allowing you to program them to do various things!
- many additional blocks to build with, provided by **Supplementaries, Amendments, Beautify, Chipped, Create Deco, Create: Design n' Decor, Create Interiors, Handcrafted, Rechiseled _and many more_**!
- Have you ever wanted to capture little moments with an in-game camera and display them as paintings in your Minecraft world? Now you can with the **Exposure mod**.
- **Friends&Foes** - adds all the fan favourites from the mob vote!

All of this, while keeping it buttery smooth!

_**NOTE**: launching the modpack will take some time though, 8+GB of ram recommended_
